objective_success_bonus: If both legs contact ground and |x| < 0.1 and |y| < 0.1 and |vy| < 0.5 and |angle| < 0.1: +200
main_engine_reward: If m_power > 0 and distance < previous_distance: +0.5 (progress-conditioned, reduced magnitude)
descent_reward: If m_power > 0 and vy < 0: +0.5 * (prev_vy - vy) where prev_vy is the previous vertical velocity (stored in self.last_vy)
hovering_penalty: If |vy| < 0.1 and distance >= previous_distance: -1.0 (increased penalty for hovering without progress)
diagnostics: distance, vy, leg_contact, angle, angular_velocity, m_power, s_power, crash, main_engine_reward, descent_reward, hovering_penalty, prev_distance
